whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Mamta's Bakery Studio,

I noticed your bakery has strong 4.5★ reviews in Fraser Road Area, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for custom cake orders and party inquiries.

Maine aapki bakery ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp cake booking, signature menu items, aur gallery integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/mamtasbakery

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Mamta's Bakery Studio team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp cake ordering and mobile-first menu showcase for Fraser Road Area. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact cakes, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
